WHO WE ARE

A small crew that treats your house like our own.

Pro 360 Construction Inc. is a small, family-owned general contracting company based in Rialto, California. We handle extraordinary reconstruction, full remodels, and repair work across the Inland Empire and Southern California — the kind of job where you want the owner showing up, not a rotating crew of subcontractors nobody vetted.

We built our name on a simple idea: charge fair, do it right the first time, and stand behind the work. That's the “360” — every project comes full circle, from demo to final walkthrough.

11+Trades under one roof
24/7Emergency leak response
100%Owner-supervised jobs

SCOPE OF WORK

Core services

One call covers the whole project — we self-perform or directly manage every trade below, so nothing falls through the cracks between contractors.

Full Renovation

Interior and exterior remodels, top to bottom.

Bath Remodels

Guest and primary bathrooms, fully reimagined.

Kitchen Remodels

Cabinets, counters, layout — done as a system.

Electrical

Panel upgrades, wiring, fixtures, and repairs.

Plumbing

Repipes, fixtures, water heaters, and leak repair.

Flooring

LVP, tile, and hard-surface installation.

Interior & Exterior Paint

Prep-heavy paint jobs that actually last.

Windows

Retrofit and replacement, energy-efficient options.

Roofing

Repairs and full re-roofs, inspected and warrantied.

Stucco

Patch, re-coat, and full exterior stucco systems.

Fencing

Wood fence builds and repair, by the linear foot.

WHAT SETS US APART

Big-builder quality.
Small-business prices.

We're owner-operated, which means no sales layer and no corporate markup between you and the crew doing the work. You get straight pricing and craftsmanship we're willing to put our name on — because it's our name on the truck.

→Direct owner oversight, every job
